description: Geometric layout region — derived organization of P4 spans + P5 column layout. NOT semantic classification. Reverse-traceable to span_id. Explicit coord_origin.
design_principles: P6 = geometric / layout region observation; P7 = semantic structure.
Region = deterministic grouping of spans from P5 column layout + density clustering.
Bounded hierarchy (2 levels): major region -> local region. No arbitrary-depth tree.
Unclear geometry -> UNKNOWN_REGION / LOW confidence, never forced assignment.
No keyword / LLM / embedding / OCR-semantic / document-specific branches.
P6 is read-only w.r.t. P1-P5 and Frozen 730.

deleted_region_types.TEXT_REGION: requires semantic text-vs-nontext knowledge; P1 has only text spans; collides with DENSE_REGION.
deleted_region_types.VISUAL_REGION: requires identifying image/figure/table; P1 skips non-text blocks; a void is not a visual object; '这是 Image' forbidden.
